seo.description: Arlington ISD elementary students start Aug. 12 and finish May 26. See breaks, parent-conference days, 12:10 p.m. early dismissal and the official calendar PDF.

hero.heading: Arlington ISD Elementary Calendar 2026-2027
hero.mobileDescription: Elementary students start August 12 and finish May 26. Early dismissal is December 18 and May 26; the regular elementary day ends at 12:10 p.m. Half-day Pre-K 3 follows separate session times.
hero.desktopDescription: Arlington ISD elementary students start Wednesday, August 12, 2026, and finish Wednesday, May 26, 2027. Early dismissal is December 18 and May 26, with the regular elementary day ending at 12:10 p.m. Half-day Pre-K 3 follows separate morning and afternoon schedules. Students are off November 23-27 for Thanksgiving, return after the winter holidays on January 6, and have spring break March 15-19.

editorialSummary.heading: Planning around the Arlington ISD elementary calendar
highlights: Regular elementary early dismissal at 12:10 p.m. on December 18 and May 26
Parent conferences on October 9 and February 12
Separate morning and afternoon schedules for half-day Pre-K 3
paragraphs: Elementary students have two early-dismissal days: Friday, December 18, 2026, and Wednesday, May 26, 2027. For the regular elementary schedule, dismissal is at 12:10 p.m., rather than 3:35 p.m. Half-day Pre-K 3 students have their own morning or afternoon session times. October 9 and February 12 are student holidays and parent-conference days; campuses provide appointment details.

The first school day is Wednesday, August 12, and the last is Wednesday, May 26. Thanksgiving break runs November 23-27. The December 21-January 1 holiday is followed by student holidays on January 4-5, so elementary students return Wednesday, January 6. Spring break is March 15-19.
March 26 and April 23 are holidays that may be used as bad-weather make-up days. Students are off unless Arlington ISD announces that either date is needed for attendance.

faqs.question: When is the first day of elementary school in Arlington ISD?
faqs.answer: The first day for Arlington ISD elementary students is Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

faqs.question: When is the last day of elementary school in Arlington ISD?
faqs.answer: The last day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. It is also an early-dismissal day, with the regular elementary day ending at 12:10 p.m. Half-day Pre-K 3 follows separate session times.

faqs.question: Does Arlington ISD have a fall break in 2026?
faqs.answer: The elementary calendar does not list a weeklong fall break. Students are off Friday, October 9, for a student holiday and parent conferences, and Monday, October 12, for a student and staff holiday.

faqs.question: When is Arlington ISD Thanksgiving break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Elementary students have no classes Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27. Classes resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Arlington ISD winter break for elementary students?
faqs.answer: The district holiday runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Student holidays on January 4-5 extend the no-class period, and students return Wednesday, January 6.

faqs.question: When is Arlington ISD spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break runs Monday, March 15, through Friday, March 19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: When are Arlington ISD elementary parent conferences?
faqs.answer: The calendar marks October 9, 2026, and February 12, 2027, as student holidays and parent-conference days. Individual campuses set appointment details.

faqs.question: Which dates have early dismissal for Arlington ISD elementary students?
faqs.answer: The elementary calendar lists early dismissal on December 18, 2026, and May 26, 2027.

faqs.question: Are Arlington ISD elementary students off September 7 and 8?
faqs.answer: Yes. September 7 is a student and staff holiday, and September 8 is a student holiday. Classes resume Wednesday, September 9.

faqs.question: Are Arlington ISD elementary students off November 2 and 3, 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. November 2 is a student and staff holiday, and November 3 is a student holiday. Elementary students return Wednesday, November 4.

faqs.question: Are Arlington ISD elementary students off February 12-16, 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. February 12 is a student holiday and parent-conference day, February 15 is a student and staff holiday, and February 16 is a student holiday. The weekend connects those dates into a five-day no-class stretch.

faqs.question: Will Arlington ISD elementary students have school on March 26 or April 23, 2027?
faqs.answer: Both dates are listed as student and staff holidays and bad-weather make-up days. They remain no-class days unless the district announces that one is needed to replace lost instructional time.

faqs.question: What are the regular Arlington ISD elementary school hours?
faqs.answer: Regular elementary hours are 8:10 a.m.-3:35 p.m. Half-day Pre-K 3 students follow separate morning or afternoon schedules. Check the district school-hours page or your campus for any campus-specific adjustments.

faqs.question: Does this calendar apply to Arlington ISD secondary or Early College students?
faqs.answer: No. Arlington ISD publishes separate Secondary, Early College High School and High School A/B calendars. Use the calendar assigned to your student's campus and program.

faqs.question: Where can families download the official Arlington ISD elementary calendar?
faqs.answer: The official PDF is linked on this page and on Arlington ISD's Calendars page. The district page says the Elementary calendar was approved January 22, 2026.

faqs.question: What time is Arlington ISD elementary early dismissal?
faqs.answer: The regular elementary day ends at 12:10 p.m. on the listed early-dismissal dates. Half-day Pre-K 3 morning sessions end at 10:10 a.m., and afternoon sessions end at 12:10 p.m.

faqs.question: What time do Arlington ISD Pre-K 3 students attend school?
faqs.answer: The district lists half-day Pre-K 3 morning hours as 8:10-11:20 a.m. and afternoon hours as 12:25-3:35 p.m. Kooken's afternoon session is 11:55 a.m.-3:05 p.m. On early-release days, morning sessions run 8:10-10:10 a.m. and afternoon sessions run 10:10 a.m.-12:10 p.m. Confirm the assigned session with your campus.

hero.heading: Arlington ISD Secondary Calendar 2026-2027
hero.mobileDescription: Secondary students start August 12 and finish May 26. Early dismissal is December 17-18 and May 25-26: 12:45 p.m. for junior high and 11:35 a.m. for high school.
hero.desktopDescription: Arlington ISD secondary students start August 12, 2026, and finish May 26, 2027. Students have four early-dismissal dates: December 17-18 and May 25-26. Junior high dismisses at 12:45 p.m. and high school at 11:35 a.m. on those dates. Spring break is March 15-19.

editorialSummary.heading: Planning around the Arlington ISD secondary calendar
highlights: Four early-dismissal dates: December 17-18 and May 25-26
Junior high dismisses at 12:45 p.m.; high school at 11:35 a.m.
High school A/B assignments are on a separate calendar
paragraphs: The Secondary calendar covers junior high and high school, but their dismissal times differ. On December 17-18 and May 25-26, junior high students leave at 12:45 p.m. and high school students at 11:35 a.m. Regular school hours are 8:45 a.m.-4:10 p.m. for junior high and 7:35 a.m.-3:00 p.m. for high school. Students following an A/B rotation should use the separate High School A/B calendar for daily letter assignments.

Classes begin August 12, 2026, and end May 26, 2027. The fall calendar includes student holidays September 7-8, October 9 and 12, and November 2-3. October 9 and February 12 are also parent-conference days. Students are off February 12-16, including the weekend, and return Wednesday, February 17.

Thanksgiving break is November 23-27. The December 21-January 1 holiday and January 4-5 student holidays keep students out of class until January 6; spring break is March 15-19. March 26 and April 23 remain holidays unless needed for bad-weather make-up time. Early College High School students have a separate calendar with different winter and TCC dates.

hero.mobileDescription: AISD classes start August 12, while TCC classes start August 17. Early College students return after the winter holidays January 13, and TCC classes resume January 19.

editorialSummary.heading: Planning around the Arlington ISD Early College calendar
highlights: AISD starts August 12; TCC starts August 17
January return: AISD on January 13, TCC on January 19
Conditional make-up dates: March 26 and April 30
paragraphs: Early College families need both the AISD and TCC dates. The first AISD school day is Wednesday, August 12, 2026; fall TCC classes begin Monday, August 17, and the TCC semester ends December 9. The Early College PDF has its own holiday schedule, so the regular Secondary calendar is not a substitute.

Winter holidays run December 21-January 8, followed by student holidays January 11-12. Students return to AISD classes Wednesday, January 13, before TCC classes begin Tuesday, January 19. The January 18 student and staff holiday falls between those return dates. December 17-18 are early-dismissal days, with the Early College school day ending at noon.

Spring break is March 15-19. March 26 and April 30 are holidays unless needed as bad-weather make-up days. The spring TCC semester ends May 12. May 25 is an early-dismissal day, and May 26 is both the final AISD student day and an early-dismissal day. Early College dismissal is at noon on those dates.

faqs.answer: No. The Early College PDF lists March 26 and April 30, 2027, as its conditional bad-weather make-up dates. April 23 appears on the regular Elementary and Secondary calendars, not as an Early College make-up date.

about.dataSource: Dates and A/B assignments come from Arlington ISD's official 2026-2027 High School Student A/B Academic Calendar and the district calendar page.
about.processing: The page summarizes the weekly rotation without turning every A or B day into a separate event. Conditional make-up dates are excluded only under the current published schedule, not permanently. The PDF prints semester totals of 82 and 89; their sum is 171, marked derived. A weekday count using the dated grid and published holidays yields 82 in semester one and 90 in semester two (172 overall). The unresolved one-day difference is in semester two; no individual attendance date has been changed or inferred to force agreement. The stored attendance statistic uses the sum of the published semester figures. The May newsletter's equal-A/B statement is not used for annual totals: the PDF's listed subtotals sum to 86 A and 85 B.
about.updates: Alternating Friday assignments and make-up-day use can change if Arlington ISD revises the calendar. This page was verified October 3, 2026.
about.disclaimer: Use the official A/B PDF and campus communications to confirm daily letter assignments, bell schedules and weather-related changes.

faqs.question: When does the Arlington ISD A/B calendar start and end?
faqs.answer: The first student day is Wednesday, August 12, 2026, and the last day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027.

faqs.question: Which weekdays are A days in Arlington ISD?
faqs.answer: The published pattern assigns Mondays and Wednesdays as A days. Fridays alternate, so students should check the official calendar for each Friday.

faqs.question: Which weekdays are B days in Arlington ISD?
faqs.answer: Tuesdays and Thursdays are B days. Alternating Fridays are printed individually on the official A/B PDF.

faqs.question: How do Friday A/B assignments work in Arlington ISD?
faqs.answer: Fridays alternate between A and B schedules rather than following one fixed letter. The official PDF marks the assignment for every Friday.

faqs.question: How many A and B days are on the 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: The PDF lists 41 A days and 41 B days in semester one, then 45 A days and 44 B days in semester two.

faqs.question: How many instructional days does the Arlington ISD A/B calendar list?
faqs.answer: The PDF lists 82 instructional days in semester one and 89 in semester two. Those semester figures add up to 171 days.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break on the A/B calendar?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes November 23-27, 2026, and return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When do A/B students return after winter break?
faqs.answer: Students return Wednesday, January 6, 2027. The December 21-January 1 holiday is followed by student holidays January 4-5.

faqs.question: When is spring break on the Arlington ISD A/B calendar?
faqs.answer: Spring break runs March 15-19, 2027, and classes resume Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: Which dates have early dismissal on the A/B calendar?
faqs.answer: Early dismissal is scheduled December 17-18, 2026, and May 25-26, 2027. High school hours on those dates are 7:35-11:35 a.m.

faqs.question: Does the Arlington ISD A/B calendar have a fall break?
faqs.answer: It does not list a weeklong fall break. Students are off October 9 and October 12, creating a four-day no-class stretch with the weekend.

faqs.question: When are parent conferences for A/B students?
faqs.answer: October 9, 2026, and February 12, 2027, are student holidays and parent-conference days. Campuses set the conference schedule.

faqs.question: Could A/B students have school on March 26 or April 23?
faqs.answer: Yes, if a bad-weather make-up day is needed. Both dates are published as holidays unless Arlington ISD activates them for attendance.

faqs.question: What are regular high school hours in Arlington ISD?
faqs.answer: The A/B calendar lists regular high school hours as 7:35 a.m.-3:00 p.m.

faqs.question: Does every Arlington ISD high school student follow the A/B calendar?
faqs.answer: Families should confirm the assigned schedule with their campus. The district publishes the A/B rotation as a separate student calendar rather than replacing the general Secondary calendar.

faqs.question: Where can students check the exact A/B assignment for a date?
faqs.answer: Use the official High School Student A/B Academic Calendar PDF. It marks individual A and B dates throughout both semesters.

faqs.question: Where can families download the official Arlington ISD A/B calendar?
faqs.answer: The official student A/B PDF is linked on this page and from Arlington ISD's Calendars page.

faqs.question: Why did Arlington ISD change the A/B pattern for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Arlington ISD's May 2026 family newsletter says the Monday/Wednesday A, Tuesday/Thursday B and alternating-Friday pattern aligns with Tarrant County College's schedule and is intended to help students enrolled in dual-credit classes.
